name: Mount Sarakura
description: Mount Sarakura (622 m) is one of Japan's New Three Great Night Views (2003), reached by cable car from Kitakyushu; its observation deck overlooks Dokai Bay and the industrial city lights.
highlights: One of the New Three Great Night Views
notes: Ropeway/cable car round trip ¥1,250. The night view is best on clear evenings; the summit has a restaurant and viewpoint.
